title: Living room to dining room
intro: A folding table and movable storage create a dining setting without rebuilding the room.
decorative_role: Durable, coordinated faces on table storage and cabinetry
review: Check hinges, load ratings, chair storage and clear circulation.

title: Living room to kitchen studio
intro: A contained cooking pod can define a cooking zone in a multi-use room.
mechanism: A serviced kitchen pod, ventilation and approved utilities
decorative_role: Replaceable pod doors and side panels
review: Water, drainage, electrical capacity, heat separation and ventilation need professional design. A finish cannot create these services.

title: Kitchen zone to sleeping zone
intro: A closed kitchen module and separate fold-down sleeping unit create a different room mode.
mechanism: Isolated kitchen module plus convertible furniture
decorative_role: Coordinated cabinetry skins across both modes
review: Cooking must be safely isolated; utilities, ventilation, clearances and local requirements must be resolved.

title: Glass to privacy wall
intro: A transparent partition can become visually opaque when a separate privacy-glazing system changes state.
decorative_role: Compatible adjacent frames and opaque decorative panels
review: Glass design, power, control safety and privacy performance are separate from architectural film.

title: Wall to television
intro: A display is integrated within a wall so the surface alternates between calm background and media.
mechanism: Display hardware, power, ventilation and controls
decorative_role: Coordinated surround and accessible service panels
review: Do not enclose ventilation or cover equipment access. A decorative sheet alone does not become a screen.

title: A room changes its surface wardrobe
intro: Mechanically attached decorative facings can be exchanged for a different atmosphere.
mechanism: Replaceable facing panels and compatible attachment
decorative_role: Seasonal colour and texture selection
review: Removal depends on the attachment and substrate. Standard bonded films are not assumed to peel cleanly or be indefinitely reusable.

title: Child’s room to guest room
intro: Modular storage and reconfigurable furniture let the room support changing household needs.
decorative_role: Renewable cabinet and partition faces
review: Maintain anchorage, edge protection, circulation and appropriate safety review.

title: Home office to playroom
intro: A fold-away desk and organised storage clear the working area after office hours.
decorative_role: Easy-to-maintain decorative storage faces
review: Manage power leads, pinch points, storage security and furniture stability.

title: A clearer route for later life
intro: Movable units and coordinated finishes can simplify circulation as mobility needs change.
decorative_role: Contrasting or tactile surface cues where appropriate
review: An accessibility professional should review dimensions, stability and individual needs. No medical benefit is promised.

title: Quiet room to shared room
intro: An acoustic partition creates a quieter zone and can reopen for family use.
decorative_role: Replaceable decorative faces on the partition
review: Acoustic performance comes from the entire assembly, seals and installation, not its appearance.

title: Bedroom daylight to privacy mode
intro: Privacy glazing and lighting change the visual relationship between a bedroom and adjoining space.
decorative_role: Soft-toned adjacent panels and cabinet faces
review: Confirm glare, privacy, controls and electrical installation; opaque appearance is not structural separation.

title: Guest suite to work suite
intro: A hotel or guest room can include a stowable work setting within its cabinetry.
decorative_role: Consistent cabinet faces between modes
review: Check ergonomics, furniture loading, sockets and housekeeping access.

title: Cabinet fronts renewed without changing the layout
intro: Exchangeable door facings can update a sound cabinet system.
decorative_role: A new finish on a retained base
review: Check hinge geometry, door weight, edge details and existing cabinet condition.

title: A kitchen island that moves
intro: A properly designed mobile unit can change preparation and dining arrangements.
mechanism: Lockable mobile furniture with suitable services
decorative_role: Coordinated end panels and storage faces
review: A decorative finish does not make plumbing mobile. Check weight, stability, brakes and safe clearances.

title: Façade panels with replaceable outer faces
intro: Modular exterior panels can allow selected facing replacement during maintenance.
decorative_role: Exterior-qualified decorative finish
review: Attachment, drainage, wind loading, fire strategy and approvals require project engineering.

title: Acoustic panels with a new visual identity
intro: Decorative faces can be selected for an acoustic module without assuming that every skin preserves its performance.
mechanism: Qualified acoustic module with reviewed facing
decorative_role: Texture and colour for the room scheme
review: Any new facing may alter acoustic or fire behaviour; evaluate the complete module.

title: Ceiling panels that coordinate light and finish
intro: Modular ceilings can integrate lighting with replaceable decorative components.
decorative_role: Decorative faces around serviceable lighting
review: Check suspended loads, heat, wiring, fire requirements and access above the ceiling.

title: A service wall for energy and equipment
intro: A modular wall can conceal approved equipment behind serviceable panels.
decorative_role: Removable decorative doors and access panels
review: Do not conceal ventilation or safety access. Battery and electrical systems require their own qualified design.

title: Yacht dining salon to rest setting
intro: Convertible seating and tables let a yacht salon change use while keeping a coherent finish palette.
decorative_role: Coordinated cabinetry and bulkhead finishes
review: Review locking, vessel movement, loads, emergency routes and vessel requirements.

title: Yacht cabin to compact workspace
intro: A fold-away desk can add a work mode without sacrificing cabin storage.
decorative_role: Wardrobe, desk surround and wall facings
review: Confirm latches, equipment ventilation, clearances and access for maintenance.

title: Ship lining with maintainable service access
intro: Panel modules can provide access to services while preserving a consistent interior finish.
decorative_role: Matched replacement metal-laminated panels
review: Seams, edge protection, fasteners and relevant fire documentation need assembly review.

title: Car trim with a different tactile character
intro: A vehicle interior may use different approved trim assemblies for different design packages.
decorative_role: Coordinated colour and tactile surface
review: Do not interfere with airbags, controls, sensors or exits. Qualification belongs to the actual part and vehicle programme.

title: Rail interior for a different service pattern
intro: An operator-led interior redesign can change storage and passenger layout for a different route.
mechanism: Qualified seating and rail interior modules
decorative_role: Durable coordinated panel finishes
review: Seat anchorage, evacuation, access, vibration and rail requirements need full engineering review.

title: Aircraft cabin panel appearance renewed
intro: A cabin alteration can update approved panel appearance within its certification process.
decorative_role: Decorative finish on the reviewed interior panel
review: New finishes require applicable flammability and alteration review; this is not an aircraft-qualified product offering.

title: Robot skins designed for replacement
intro: A service robot could use replaceable tactile coverings around a designed housing.
decorative_role: Synthetic-leather appearance and touch
review: Review flexibility, cleanability, attachment, motion and sensor compatibility. Human-skin use is a separate research question.

title: Furniture surfaces with integrated touch controls
intro: A surface could accommodate a separate sensor and control system within a furniture module.
decorative_role: Decorative surrounding surfaces
review: Confirm electrical safety, service access, coating thickness and sensor response in the actual construction.

title: A visual skin that changes with the room
intro: Display or lighting modules can create changeable imagery beside passive material finishes.
decorative_role: Replaceable passive frames and adjacent skins
review: Power, heat, optics and controls are hardware questions. A passive decorative film is not a dynamic display.

title: Space-habitat living to plant module
intro: A future habitat could allocate a serviced module between living and growing functions.
mechanism: Life-support, controlled agriculture and habitat engineering
decorative_role: Durable cleanable service panels
review: This is a research vision. Atmosphere, water, light, contamination control and mission qualification require dedicated systems.

title: Marine interior with a contained grow module
intro: A contained growing unit could be explored within unused onboard interior space.
mechanism: A secured agriculture module and services
decorative_role: Qualified surrounding panel finishes
review: Humidity, power, water, stability and vessel requirements need review. Decorative surfaces do not provide food-safety or growing performance.

title: A material passport for the next renewal
intro: A digital panel record can make later repair and replacement more precise.
mechanism: A maintained component and material record
decorative_role: Traceable finish references and batch identity
review: Record construction, adhesives, grade, location, repairs and available recycling routes; do not assume every composite is recyclable.
